newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius rupee firms on dollar, weaker on pound.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius rupee firms on dollar, weaker on pound.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee firmed against the dollar but weakened versus the pound on Wednesday, commercial forex dealers said.
The rupee traded at a mean rate of 19.9935 against the dollar from 20.0310 on Tuesday. Against the pound, the rupee was posted at a mean of 33.5530 from 33.4535 on Tuesday.
Dealers said the firmer rupee still reflected dollar supply by the central bank through interventions in the interbank forex market on Monday and Tuesday.
"With the intervention rates lower than interbank, the rupee is being supported," one dealer said.
The central bank said it sold 4.30 million dollars at 19.95 rupees for one dollar during Tuesday's intervention and 1.80 million dollars at 19.98 rupees per dollar on Monday.
On Monday, the rupee was trading at a mean commercial rate of 20.1065 for one dollar.
